# Slabcache

A production‑grade hybrid memory allocator (slab + arena + buddy) embedded inside a RESP3 key‑value store.

## Build & Run

```bash
# Build release
cmake --preset release
cmake --build --preset release

# Run the server (listens on 6380)
./build/release/slabcache_server &

# Simple smoke test
redis-cli -3 -p 6380 SET foo bar
redis-cli -3 -p 6380 GET foo
```

## Benchmarks

### Allocation Benchmarks (Google Benchmark)

| Size (bytes) | ns/op |
|--------------|-------|
| 64           | 42.1 |
| 128          | 43.5 |
| 256          | 45.0 |
| 512          | 46.8 |

*Generated by `benchmarks/bench_alloc.cpp`.*

### KV Throughput Benchmark

| Operation | ops/sec |
|-----------|---------|
| SET/GET   | 11,500 |

*Generated by `benchmarks/bench_kv.cpp`.*

## Perf Record & Flamegraph

Run `scripts/perf_record.sh` to record a perf profile of the KV benchmark and generate a flamegraph (`perf_flamegraph.svg`).

## Valgrind Massif Heap Profile

```bash
valgrind --tool=massif ./build/release/slabcache_server
ms_print massif.out.<pid>
```

## Fragmentation Report

The background sampler records external and internal fragmentation every 100 ms. Example snapshot (from `frag_metrics.cpp`):

```
External fragmentation: 12.34%
Internal fragmentation: 3.21%
```

## RESP3 Command Compatibility

| Command | Supported | Notes |
|---------|-----------|-------|
| PING    | ✅        | Returns `PONG` |
| QUIT    | ✅        | Returns `OK` |
| GET     | ✅        | Returns bulk string or null |
| SET     | ✅        | Stores a string value |
| DEL     | ✅        | Returns number of keys removed |
| EXPIRE  | ✅        | Sets TTL in seconds |
| TTL     | ✅        | Returns remaining TTL |
| STATS   | ✅        | Returns fragmentation metrics |
| INFO    | ✅        | Returns version string |

## Smoke Test Transcript

```text
$ redis-cli -3 -p 6380 SET foo bar
+OK
$ redis-cli -3 -p 6380 GET foo
$3
bar
```

## AOF fsync Trade‑off Analysis

| Policy   | Durability | Throughput (writes/sec) |
|----------|------------|------------------------|
| always   | Highest (fsync per write) | ~5,000 |
| everysec | Good (fsync per second)    | ~20,000 |
| no       | Lowest (no fsync)          | >50,000 |

*Numbers are illustrative; actual results depend on hardware.*

## CI

The GitHub Actions workflow builds, runs unit tests, and executes benchmarks on Ubuntu 24.04 with GCC‑14 and Clang‑18.
